name: rea-analysis-companion
description: An independent, evidence-first guide for authorized reverse-engineering workflows with the open-source REA toolset.

interface.longDescription: An independent, multi-skill companion for planning and interpreting authorized reverse-engineering work with morluto/rea. It helps route binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, websites, Android packages, firmware, captures, and other artifacts to the right REA workflow; plan scoped investigations; preserve evidence and uncertainty; and explain results. This is not an official REA product, does not include or operate REA's local MCP server, does not analyze files by itself, and does not make analysis safe or sandboxed. Use only artifacts and systems you own or are authorized to assess.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan an authorized REA investigation of this artifact.
Route this target to the right REA workflow and list prerequisites.
Turn these REA findings into an evidence-linked report with unknowns.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: multi-skill guidance for scoped, authorized REA investigations, target routing, evidence handling, runtime safety, and clear reporting.
